title: grant_revocation.v1
description: Withdraws a previously-issued capability grant. Carried as the payload of a Treeship receipt with kind=grant_revocation.v1. Honored only when the signer is the grant's own grantor: a revocation anyone could mint would be a denial-of-service against every grant whose id they knew. Revocation is evaluated at the action's signed_at, so an action signed BEFORE the revocation instant stays valid -- withdrawing authority is not the same as retroactively unmaking what was already done under it.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Must be exactly this value.

grant_id.description: Content-derived id (grn_...) of the grant being withdrawn.

grantor.description: Ed25519 public key of the grant's issuer, base64url-no-pad. Recorded so a verifier can confirm the revocation was signed by the party that issued the grant, without re-resolving the grant itself.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason, e.g. compromised, task-complete, scope-error, key-rotation.

revoked_at.description: RFC 3339 instant the grant was withdrawn. An action whose signed_at is at or after this instant is unauthorized; one signed strictly before it is not affected.
